criteria.name: artwork_craft
criteria.why: Strong frames on 3, 8, 6 and 2. The cover shows concentric banding in the sky and a wide empty grey middle band. Kit figures on 4 and 9 read as mannequins, the trap is a plain cylinder, the drone's lamp is a flat blue disc, slide 5 reads as a chart on a floor with the worker cut by the right edge, slide 6 is top-loaded, and slide 3 reads as a forest at feed size.

criteria.name: deck_coherence
criteria.why: One last-light brush world, one bluebonnet accent meaning what the response sends, barbed wire from 1 to 4 to 8 to 9, a working scale-ladder camera. The map and stone frames lift the filmstrip's value at 2 and 6.

criteria.name: claim_integrity
criteria.why: Every numeral traces. Slide 7 scopes no case to the animals observed and the caption adds that the finding covers only those animals. Slides 1 and 6 say AI models choose where flies go where c2 says USDA uses insights from the models. The drone figures rest on KRGV alone.

criteria.name: story_and_stakes
criteria.why: What happened, who acts and what the AI does, and an unusually actionable close with a number. Slide 2 never names the 12 zone counties or what movement restrictions require.

criteria.name: sequence_and_momentum
criteria.why: Reads well in order with a declared turn at 8. Slide 6 is an aside; slide 7's no case sits four frames from slide 3's 43 premises without saying the counts measure different things.

criteria.name: voice
criteria.why: On register and regional, honest about the limit. Slide 8's 'names one especially' is flat.

criteria.name: variety
criteria.why: Fresh topic, world and palette; the type-top chassis and the unit-count device recur.

one_sentence_fix: On slide 2, name the 12 zone counties c29 lists and say what the movement restriction means for moving cattle there.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Visible concentric banding in the sky between the dek and the seam and a wide empty grey middle band.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Dither the sky gradient and move the camera closer so the windmill climbs into the empty sky.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: The kit rancher and Hereford read as a mannequin and a toy shown full length.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Reframe over the rancher's shoulder at the latch so the chained latch and hand are the lit foreground.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: The full-length worker reads as a mannequin and the trap is a plain cylinder.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Bring the trap into the near foreground at chest height with its mesh, lid and bait cup.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: The drone's lamp is a flat unlit blue disc.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: An emissive lens with a small bloom and a faint cool cone on the nearest cattle.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Reads as a chart on a floor and the worker is cut by the right edge.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Move the worker fully inside the frame and add small leader labels for capacity and the planned plant.
